steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Retrieval means finding information that is directly stated in the text. You don't need to guess or interpret - the answer is right there in black and white. | : Top Tips: Write in your own words where possible (but keep close to the text) You can use bullet points or numbered lists Each point should be a complete idea Don't repeat the same point in different words | Examiner's Tip: This is one of the easiest questions on the paper. Don't overthink it - just find four things and write them down. Aim to complete this in about 5 minutes. | Retrieval Exam Strategy: This is the easiest question on the paper - don't overcomplicate it. For AQA Paper 1 Q1 (4 marks), spend no more than 5 minutes.
